Card C02923-K1 has an established history of mixed-channel use including 21 prior online transactions and 6 purchases in product category R, with regular in-person usage in region 330 before and after the alert.

The transaction amount of $100.07 is consistent with typical purchase amounts for this card (recent grocery and merchandise transactions average $116 to $141), with no bursts or card testing sequences.

case.summary: Transaction 3523199 ($100.07, online) on card C02923-K1 was alerted due to an elevated legacy risk score of 0.54. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.005, corresponding to an empirical historical fraud rate of 0.6%. The purchase occurred within the cardholder's primary billing region 330 and aligned with their regular transaction sizes and online purchasing patterns. Although device D000178 was recorded as new to the account, it is a generic iPad profile shared across 112 cards with no proxy use or fraud ring association. Regular in-person activity in region 330 continued uninterrupted both before and after the alert, with no customer dispute reported. The transaction was determined to be legitimate and closed.
